acc: Layers rule (Jonathan 2026-10-19): a fact a board item keys (the answer, or the clue that rules out a distractor) must stay visible, not only in a hover. Report a keyed fact found only in a hover.

Brief set rules (Jonathan 2026-10-20): every practice item carries three reasons ("reasons: key | d1 | d2" on its item line), each the choice's defining feature or the fact in the stem that rules it out; a distractor that is a differential row reuses that row's wording. Judge each reason for Step 2 truth on that stem and agreement with the body and the item's explanation.
Every age, cutoff, duration and interval against the cited quote and the board sources in facts.json (kind board first).
read: Prose rules (Jonathan 2026-10-19): captions, labels, zone names and cells use the term a clinician or textbook uses, never a euphemism or figurative phrasing; a list of tests is broken up, one test or one group per line.
Diagnoses with other names show them at first mention and in their differential row (ALIASES.json); abbreviations follow ABBREV.json.
Each item's three reasons stand alone under their choice after an answer and read as a parallel set.
flags: The per-choice reasons on each item line count as lines: a reason stating a number, an age, or an absolute word (always, never, only, must) its item's claims and quotes do not support is a finding.
display: Layers rule (Jonathan 2026-10-19): the visible layer must scan on the phone: short cells, nothing buried, no text squeezed into a narrow column (widen, never shorten). Judge each timeline and course tile (septic-hip and sjia Time course, growing-pains Time course, nursemaid After reduction, bone-tumors What each lesion does next) and the bone-tumors Site and age lookup table at phone width.

First step pairing (Jonathan 2026-10-20): in each First step band, each order heads only its own results (one row group per order); on phone the order and its results span the full width; in study mode the answers and only the answers are hidden.
